verdict.rationale: The only documented OpenAI-compatible endpoint is the hosted Wally cloud API at inference.runanywhere.ai; the docs state the on-device SDKs have no HTTP surface. Local CLI execution and one-command tool integrations are documented, but no local API server is, so a hosted endpoint is an adjacent capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model
